rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enforces project scope boundaries for AI-assisted work by detecting when tasks exceed agreed-upon parameters. Analyzes work items against defined contracts to flag scope creep and automatically drafts change order responses for out-of-scope requests. Configured via a mcpize.yaml file for project-specific scope definitions.
